annotations.title: Check a budget against a cost or return goal

description: Work out whether a monthly budget can reach a target cost per acquisition or return on ad spend, and whether it produces enough weekly conversions for automated delivery to leave the learning phase. Nothing is filled in from industry averages: for any input not supplied, it solves for the value the goal would require and labels it as a condition rather than a forecast.

ad_sets.description: How many ad sets or campaigns the budget is split across.

avg_order_value.description: Average order value, required with a return goal.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts supplied.

expected_cpc.description: Cost per click. Supply it only if measured or quoted.

expected_cvr.description: Conversion rate, as 0.03 or 3 for three percent. Supply it only if measured.

target_roas.description: Target return on ad spend, as a multiple such as 4 for 4x.

name: estimate_budget_feasibility
